title: VerificationModel
description: Schema for a closing amount verification record created by the attorney. Captures the full financial breakdown, attorney signature, checklist state, and outcome (verified or flagged).

verificationId.description: Unique verification record identifier. Format: VER-XXXXX.

transactionId.description: The transaction this verification record belongs to.

attorneyId.description: Identifier of the closing attorney (AT) who performed this verification.

attorneySignature.description: Full name typed by the attorney as their electronic signature. Required when outcome is 'verified'. Null for flagged outcomes.

outcome.description: Result of the attorney's review. 'in_progress' is a transient state while the attorney is working.

financials.description: Financial breakdown verified by the attorney. All amounts in USD.

salePrice.description: Contract sale price of the property.

downPayment.description: Down payment amount. Must equal salePrice minus loanAmount.

closingCosts.description: Total closing costs (title fees, attorney fees, taxes, etc.).

cashToClose.description: Total cash the buyer must bring to closing. Equals downPayment plus closingCosts.

closingDate.description: Scheduled closing date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

agentName.description: Name of the real estate agent.

progressStep.description: Current step in the 5-step verification pipeline at the time this record was created or last updated. Step 3 = Attorney Review (active when verification is submitted).

checklist.description: Attorney's verification checklist state at time of submission.

attorneyNotes.description: Optional notes entered by the attorney during the verification review.

discrepancy.description: Populated only when outcome is 'flagged'. Null for verified outcomes.

type.description: Classification of the discrepancy identified by the attorney.

description.description: Detailed description of the discrepancy written by the attorney.

notifiedParties.description: Roles notified of this discrepancy flag.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this verification record was created (attorney clicked Verify All Amounts or Flag Discrepancy).

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update to this record.

examples.attorneyNotes: All amounts confirmed against submitted closing disclosure. Awaiting final signature page.
